NAVY

Lockheed Martin Corp., Fort Worth, Texas, is awarded a $1,250,000,000 fixed-price-incentive-fee modification (P00001) to previously awarded contract N00019-25-C-0001 for F-35 Lot 19 production. Work will be performed in Fort Worth, Texas (60%), and is expected to be completed in December 2030. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

Example Shipbuilding LLC,* Norfolk, Virginia, has been awarded a $12,500,000 firm-fixed-price contract for ship repair. This contract was competitively procured via the SAM.gov website. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity (N00024-26-C-4321).

AIR FORCE

Sikorsky Aircraft Corp., Stratford, Connecticut, was awarded a $48,500,000 firm-fixed-price contract for HH-60W sustainment. Work will be performed at Stratford, Connecticut. Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity (FA8625-26-C-0042).

*Small business

The Department of Defense is not making any further statement.
